preserves: Versions 0.1.0 and 0.2.0 remain frozen for their observed cases.
extension_summary: represents multiple independently counted page-budget scopes
records cross-document delegation and domain-specific source authority
represents missing delegated sources without silently inferring their rules
applies volume-specific content and page-format policies
keeps draft TOC generation available while consortium and RPA gates remain HOLD

page_budget_modes.RFP_EXACT: target_pages is required and the counted leaves in this budget must equal it
page_budget_modes.RFP_UNLIMITED: target_pages is null and the scope is not part of exact-page completion
page_budget_modes.RFP_UNSPECIFIED: target_pages is null and allocation remains HOLD until an explicit planning target is supplied

operations: preserve every official RFP parent and level
place delegated technical obligations below the applicable official parent
assign exactly one MAIN mapping per proposal-body obligation
calculate each page budget from leaf rows only
emit workbook and RPA specification in HOLD when a delegated source or human gate is unresolved

reimport_contract.new_row_rule: Unknown or blank node_id is NEW and receives a provisional stable identifier.
reimport_contract.regeneration_rule: No TOC, page budget, or RPA specification is regenerated without an explicit human command.

invariants.official_structure: An RFP-fixed parent and level cannot change; title may change.
invariants.level_limit: Levels 1 through 3 are routine; level 4 requires review.
invariants.main_rule: Each non-control atomic obligation has exactly one MAIN mapping.
invariants.authority_rule: Source authority is domain-specific and delegated sources are not replaced by inference.
invariants.page_budget_rule: Each counted leaf belongs to one page budget; completion is evaluated independently per budget.
invariants.unlimited_rule: RFP_UNLIMITED has no target and cannot make an exact budget pass or fail.
invariants.format_rule: A3 changes are always detected; a prohibited format produces BLOCK rather than a count multiplier.
invariants.content_policy_rule: A scoped forbidden-content policy must be reviewed before release.
invariants.release_rule: RPA release always requires an explicit human release command.

BLOCK: missing authoritative source required for release

non_goals: automatic regeneration after every external input
reopening_conditions: a later case cannot be represented without semantic loss
one leaf must belong to multiple counted budgets
source authority cannot be expressed by domain and delegation
a content policy cannot be scoped to the affected volume or document
